name: MayaPublisher
description: Publishes the active Maya scene using a Ticket Script the artist picks from this tool's own bundled maya-scripts/MayaPublisher/tickets/<Category>/ folder, into the pipeline publish folder whose Custom Path label matches that category, versioned via PublishApi. Its "Maya Publisher" section batch-publishes many scenes at once, running each in its own headless mayapy (or a Maya window for tickets that need a viewport) with the same env Maya Launcher uses. Also contributes its maya-scripts folder to the Maya Launcher env bridge.
